text:
Marta (People Ops): Quick sync — Alex (incoming, TN->H-1 transfer) has a consular appointment in Mexico City next week. He asked if we can cover courier fees and provide an employer letter confirming paid leave and intent to employ. Can we finalize today?
Oliver (Recruiter): Offer already signed, start date tentatively June 1. Candidate asked specifically for an employer letter that states title, salary, and that the position is full-time remote (US-based payroll).
Rita (Immigration Counsel): For TN->H-1 transfers consulate typically wants employer letter + job duties + proof of qualification. I'll draft the legal language. Also recommend a short "project timeline" paragraph to show why timing matters.
Sam T (Eng Manager): Role blurb: "Alex will be Staff ML Engineer on the Serving Runtime team, responsible for runtime performance, batching, and kernel integration for production LLM models. He will lead the inference-sharding workstream (SR-2026)." OK to include?
Marta (People Ops): Yes. Oliver — can you confirm the exact salary as written in the offer (currency) so the letter matches?
Oliver (Recruiter): Confirmed: USD 185,000 base. I'll DM the signed offer PDF to Marta.
Alex C (candidate): Thanks everyone. I also need the company to pre-approve DHL express for passport return — my last stamping took 6 business days. Per the offer I believe visa travel is reimbursed; can we get pre-approval to avoid out-of-pocket?
Payroll Bot: Company policy: economy travel and visa-related courier up to $300 pre-approved; express courier >$300 requires manager approval + receipts. Pre-approval request should be submitted in expenses portal.
Marta (People Ops): We'll cover up to $300 automatically. Sam — can you approve manager sign-off if candidate needs >$300?
Sam T (Eng Manager): I can approve up to $500 for urgent courier. Approve in thread.
Rita (Immigration Counsel): Draft employer letter snippet: "Date: Apr 20, 2026
To: Consular Section, Embassy of Mexico
Re: Support for visa stamping â€” Alex Cruz (passport xxxxxx)

Redwood Inference confirms the offer of employment to Alex Cruz as Staff ML Engineer with annual base salary USD 185,000. Alex will work on Serving Runtime (project SR-2026) and is essential to a Q3 customer deployment. We confirm company-sponsored paid travel for the consular appointment and that employment is expected to commence June 1, 2026.

Contact: Marta (people-ops@redwood.ai)."
Marta (People Ops): I'll put that on letterhead and route to Legal. Rita, can you add one sentence about Alex's unique skills (e.g., distributed KV cache optimization) for the impact paragraph?
Rita (Immigration Counsel): Added mention of "distributed KV cache optimization and latency-critical kernel experience". Legal review will take ~24 hours.
Oliver (Recruiter): Alex, I've submitted the pre-approval for $350 (requested DHL) in expenses and noted Sam as approver. Please attach the courier quote so we can expedite.
Alex C (candidate): Uploaded DHL quote to the expense request. Thank you.
Sam T (Eng Manager): Approved $350 courier in expense portal.
Payroll Bot: Note: For benefits and payroll onboarding, candidate must complete I-9 remote verification and bank details before payroll cutoff May 25. If physical start moves past June 15, benefits enrollment will shift to next cycle.
Marta (People Ops): Oliver — confirm candidate availability for remote I-9 appointment (we have slots Apr 28-30).
Oliver (Recruiter): Alex booked Apr 29 11am PT.
Alex C (candidate): Confirmed. One more question: can the employer letter say we will hold my position if stamping is delayed? The consulate asked for that wording last time.
Rita (Immigration Counsel): We can say "position will be held" for brief administrative delays, but avoid guaranteeing extended employment; stick to factual start date intent. I'll phrase: "Redwood will hold the position for administrative processing delays of up to 30 days."
Marta (People Ops): Good. I'll finalize letter text, send to Legal, and post signed PDF here when ready. Everyone ack when salary/manager blurb/courier approval are final.
Sam T (Eng Manager): Ack  manager blurb and courier approved.
Oliver (Recruiter): Ack  salary confirmed and I-9 scheduled.
Alex C (candidate): Ack  DHL quote uploaded. Appreciate the help.
people-ops-bot: Thread saved to #people-ops archives for audit.
